name: Quota Presence
description: Writes how much quota is left on each AI provider as one status line (status.json) for the bot's Discord custom status. Reads agy /usage, OpenClaw's provider usage and, if enabled, Claude Code's own plan usage; no model calls.

items.label: What to show
items.help: "auto" (every source found) or a list of { label, source, window, windows }. source is a group such as agy:gemini-4-argon, usage:openai or claude-code; window is min (the tightest limit, default), 5h or week; windows: ["5h","week"] shows several through {windows}.

template.label: Status template
template.help: {items} is replaced by the items joined with the separator; {time} by HH:MM. Cut to 128 UTF-16 code units (Discord's limit).

itemTemplate.label: Item template
itemTemplate.help: Default "{label} {remaining}%". Also {used}, {window}, {reset} (time until reset: 45m / 3h / 2d), {resetAt} (when: 10/28 16:04), {windows} (every window of the item), {stale} (staleMark when the numbers are old).

windowTemplate.label: Window template
windowTemplate.help: One window inside {windows}. Default "{window} {remaining}%"; same placeholders as the item template.

windowLabels.label: Window names
windowLabels.help: Names for {window}, e.g. { "5h": "5h", "week": "1w" }. Unlisted windows show their id.

resetAtFormat.label: Reset time format
resetAtFormat.help: {resetAt}: YYYY, M, MM, D, DD, H, HH, mm; the rest is literal. Default "M/D HH:mm", in timeZone (default Asia/Tokyo).

resetAtTodayFormat.label: Reset time format (today)
resetAtTodayFormat.help: Used instead of resetAtFormat when the reset is today, e.g. "HH:mm". Unset: always resetAtFormat.

minUpdateIntervalMs.label: Minimum gap after a turn (ms)
minUpdateIntervalMs.help: agent_end refreshes at most this often; a turn inside the gap schedules one refresh at its end. Default 120000.

startDelayMs.label: First refresh after (ms)
startDelayMs.help: Wait this long after the service starts before the first refresh. Default 10000.

staleAfterMs.label: Keep old numbers for (ms)
staleAfterMs.help: When a source fails, its last numbers stay up this long. Default 10800000 (3 hours); 0 keeps them forever.

markStaleAfterMs.label: Mark numbers as old after (ms)
markStaleAfterMs.help: {stale} shows staleMark (default "*") for numbers fetched longer ago than this. Default 2 × intervalMs + 5 minutes (35 minutes); 0 never marks.

staleMark.label: Old-numbers mark
staleMark.help: What {stale} shows for old numbers. Default "*".

agy.label: Antigravity CLI
agy.help: { enabled, command, args, timeoutMs (30000), lockFile }. Runs `agy -p /usage` (no model call). On by default.

usage.label: OpenClaw provider usage
usage.help: { enabled, providers, timeoutMs, agentDir, module }. Reads the same numbers as /status, inside the Gateway. On by default.

claudeCode.label: Claude Code login
claudeCode.help: { enabled, credentialsFile, timeoutMs (10000) }. Off by default. Reads the plan usage (5h, week, model-scoped weeks) of the account Claude Code is logged in with — the one the claude-cli runtime uses — from GET api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage, the request Claude Code's /usage makes. The token is read from Claude Code's credentials file ($CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude/.credentials.json), never refreshed or logged. Group: claude-code.

footer.label: Reply footer
footer.help: { enabled, template, channels, maxLength (300) }, plus its own items, itemTemplate, separator, missingTemplate, windowTemplate, windowSeparator, windowLabels, resetAtFormat, resetAtTodayFormat, resetPrecision, timeZone; any left out come from the main config. Adds one "-# …" line under each outgoing message, from the cached numbers. Off by default; while on, Discord's streamed reply preview is off. Changing enabled takes `openclaw plugins reload quota-presence`.

statusFile.label: Status file
statusFile.help: Where the line is written ({ text, items, updatedAt }). Default <state dir>/quota-presence/status.json. automation/set-presence.js reads it and sets the Discord custom status.
